Name: (Unofficial) Overgrown Fairy Craftables - Compatible with 1.6
Author: jibyo
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I really like the original Overgrown Fairy Craftables by Linbun but was sad it didn't work with 1.6 so I updated it myself. I am in no way an artist and didn't make any new textures and only used the existing assets and made it compatible. I am uploading this from the reminder of many requests that I completely forgot about so if there is any issue please let me know and I can fix it back up![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Place in /mods folder[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Fan update of Overgrown Fairy Craftables, a re-texture mod

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires Content Patcher[/color][/size]
